newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.091pts to 102.451.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.091pts to 102.451.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.091 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.451, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.396 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose by 0.140 points to 99.143 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.267 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 lost 5.130 points to 1,069.118.
